sourceMapping.rule: Retain native glyph occurrences, real replica/metadata, every paper, line, roller, clip and painter order

sourceProof.interval: Every lyric and blank strip retains source paper/string/hole/shadow and clock. Hold sway +/-2.5, full sway +/-22.5 degrees. Source local drop stays in [-.25H,+.05H], from clamped outBack(s=1.6). Branch/leaves have no text and are drawn before strips. They are explicit background supports; horizontal offset is constrained to zero so native edge supports and reveal clock remain unchanged.
sourceProof.stageProof: Per-source pivot/trigonometric/drop/scale intervals enclose every primary owned event. Every blank panel, crest, body, cap, rib and lyric stays classified; camera interval and joint replay preserve clips and connections.
sourceProof.limitations: Cut/still text motion only; unsupported source domains fail explicitly

scope: Local independent immutable native before/after; no image inspection by implementation agent; no public operation
